COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
D-34
WPSS No. 1144 of 2025
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Abhishek Pant, Advocate for the 
petitioners, through video conferencing.
Mr. Ganesh Kandpal, Deputy 
Advocate General for the State.
Mr. B.D. Pande, Advocate for the 
Uttarakhand Subordinate Service Selection 
Commission (“UKSSSC”).
Heard.
Admit.
Learned CSC takes notice for the 
respondent nos. 2 & 3.
Mr. B.D. Pande, Advocate takes notice 
for the respondent no. 1.
Issue notices to the private 
respondents, returnable within six weeks. 
Steps to be taken within a week.
Counter affidavit to be filed within 
three weeks.
Two weeks thereafter, rejoinder 
affidavit, if any, may be filed.
List on 08.09.2025.
Heard on interim relief application. 
It is the case of the petitioners that 
they responded to an advertisement issued 
by the UKSSSC for the position of 
Draftsman in the Irrigation Department; 
now the result has been declared; the 
petitioners belong to the OBC category; they
have secured more marks than the general 
category (women), therefore, the petitioners ought to have been given offer of 
appointment; but, by not doing so, the 
rules of reservation as laid down in the 
cases of Saurav Yadav v. State of Uttar 
Pradesh, AIR 2021 SC 233 and Sadhana 
Singh Dangi and others v. Pinki Asati and 
others, (2022) 12 SCC 401, have been 
violated.
By means of the interim relief 
application, the petitioners seek direction 
that operation of the result may be stayed.
The selected candidates have also 
been made parties. They have been issued 
notices. 
Having considered, as an interim 
measure, it is directed that any action that 
has been taken pursuant to the result 
dated 25.06.2025 as issued by the UKSSSC 
and/or the appointment of the private 
respondents shall remain subject to final 
outcome of the instant writ petition.
Interim relief application stands
disposed of accordingly.
 
 (Ravindra Maithani J.) 
11.07.2025
Avneet/
